title: Plate-YOLO: An End-to-End Object Detection Framework for Robust Astrometric Registration of Historical Plates

problem.summary: Historical astronomical plates provide a long temporal baseline for time-domain astrophysics, but degradation and structural artifacts can hinder automated astrometric calibration.
statements: Historical astronomical plates provide a long temporal baseline for time-domain astrophysics, but degradation and structural artifacts can hinder automated astrometric calibration.
We present PlateYOLO, a framework that combines source detection and stellar classification in one detector and supplies source catalogs to a separate astrometric solver.
The detector adapts YOLOv5 with Space-toDepth feature rearrangement, SimAM attention, a high-resolution P2 head, and a Normalized Wasserstein Distance loss for small bounding boxes.
